verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires the landing-page layout to include responsive behavior across the frontend and UI design.
Target-specific implementation claim: the delivered landing-page package includes desktop, tablet, and mobile styling.
The client establishes an implementation-relevant intermediate breakpoint to prevent hero text and image overlap on laptop-sized displays; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
First concrete verification for the intermediate laptop-width path: the client observed substantially improved display after adding the overlap-prevention breakpoint.
